name: New Bedford
note_en: Ishmael visits the city before taking ship for Nantucket; the marker represents the city as a whole
note: 以实玛利去楠塔基特搭船之前来到这座城市；标记代表整座城市

name: Nantucket
note_en: Melville describes the island as a remote sandy outpost; the marker represents the island as a whole
note: 梅尔维尔将这座岛描写为偏远的沙地前哨；标记代表全岛

name: Walden Pond
note_en: Thoreau describes the pond and his life beside it; the marker represents the pond, not an exact cabin location
note: 梭罗描写这座湖泊以及湖畔生活；标记代表湖泊，并非木屋的精确位置

name: Washington, D.C.
note_en: Whitman records visiting wartime hospitals across the city; this is a city-wide marker
note: 惠特曼记录了在全城探望战时医院的经历；此标记代表整座城市

name: Falmouth
note_en: Whitman departs from the military camp at Falmouth with wounded soldiers; the marker represents the town
note: 惠特曼与伤兵一起离开法尔茅斯的军营；标记代表城镇

name: Camden
note_en: Whitman returns to Camden and describes a night crossing of the Delaware; the city marker is not a ferry position
note: 惠特曼返回卡姆登，描写夜渡特拉华河的景象；城市标记并非渡轮所在位置

name: Pittsburgh
note_en: Whitman describes the industrial city during his 1879 railway journey; the marker represents the city
note: 惠特曼在一八七九年的铁路旅途中描写这座工业城市；标记代表全城

name: Orchard House
note_en: Alcott wrote and set Little Women at Orchard House; the fictional March family room is not a measured description of the surviving interior
note: 奥尔科特在果园居写作《小妇人》，并以此为故事背景；马奇家的虚构房间并非现存室内的实测描写

name: Great Neck
note_en: Great Neck is associated with the novel’s West Egg; this marker represents the community, not Gatsby’s fictional mansion
note: 大颈镇与小说中的西卵相对应；此标记代表社区，而非盖茨比虚构的豪宅

name: The Plaza Hotel
note_en: Jordan tells Nick about Daisy and Gatsby while they sit in the hotel’s tea garden
note: 乔丹在饭店茶园里向尼克讲述黛西与盖茨比的往事

name: Sullivan’s Island
note_en: Poe places Legrand’s retreat on this island; the marker represents the island, not the fictional hut
note: 坡将勒格朗的隐居处设在这座岛上；标记代表岛屿，而非虚构的小屋

name: Charleston
note_en: The narrator lives in Charleston and travels to visit Legrand; this is a city-wide marker
note: 叙述者住在查尔斯顿，并从那里前往勒格朗的住处；此标记代表全城

name: Wilmington
note_en: The fictional Wellington reworks Wilmington and the white-supremacist violence of 1898; the marker represents the city
note: 虚构的威灵顿以威尔明顿及一八九八年的白人至上主义暴力事件为基础；标记代表全城

name: Clyde
note_en: Anderson’s childhood town helped shape fictional Winesburg; the marker is not the separate real town named Winesburg
note: 安德森童年居住的城镇启发了虚构的温斯堡；此标记并非另一座真实存在的同名城镇

name: Franconia
note_en: The title poem remembers election results displayed at a film screening in Franconia; the marker represents the town
note: 标题诗回忆弗兰科尼亚一次电影放映中公布选举结果的情景；标记代表城镇

name: Georgetown
note_en: Townsend’s fictionalized account sends Patty Cannon to jail here; the marker represents the town, not a surviving jail
note: 汤森的小说化叙述写到帕蒂·坎农被押往这里的监狱；标记代表城镇，并非现存监狱

name: Princess Anne
note_en: The novel opens with the town’s courts, churches and social hierarchy; the marker represents the town
note: 小说开篇描写城镇的法院、教堂及社会等级；标记代表城镇

name: Harriet Beecher Stowe House, Hartford
name_zh: 哈特福德 · 哈丽特·比彻·斯托故居
note_en: Harriet Beecher Stowe lived here from 1873 until her death in 1896. Her later home is now a public house museum at the Stowe Center for Literary Activism; Uncle Tom’s Cabin had been published in 1852, before she lived here
note: 哈丽特·比彻·斯托从一八七三年起住在这里，直至一八九六年去世。这座晚年故居如今是斯托文学行动中心对公众开放的故居博物馆；《汤姆叔叔的小屋》早在一八五二年便已出版，并非在此写成

name: Harriet Beecher Stowe House, Brunswick
name_zh: 布伦斯威克 · 哈丽特·比彻·斯托故居
note_en: Harriet Beecher Stowe and her family rented this house from 1850 to 1852, when she wrote Uncle Tom’s Cabin. It now belongs to Bowdoin College and contains faculty offices; scheduled public access is limited to Harriet’s Writing Room. The house is not a setting of the novel
note: 哈丽特·比彻·斯托与家人于一八五〇至一八五二年租住此屋，其间写作《汤姆叔叔的小屋》。房屋现属鲍登学院，内设教师办公室；公众只能按开放安排参观哈丽特写作室。这里并非小说的故事地点

name: Providence Athenaeum
name_zh: 普罗维登斯雅典娜图书馆
note_en: Edgar Allan Poe and Sarah Helen Whitman visited this library during their 1848 courtship; she ended their relationship here on December 23. It remains a member-supported library open to visitors. Poe did not live here, and The Gold-Bug is not set here
note: 埃德加·爱伦·坡与莎拉·海伦·惠特曼在一八四八年交往期间到访这座图书馆；十二月二十三日，她在这里结束了两人的关系。这里如今仍是向访客开放的会员制图书馆。坡并未居住于此，《金甲虫》的故事也不发生在这里

name: Robert Frost Stone House Museum
name_zh: 沙夫茨伯里 · 罗伯特·弗罗斯特石屋博物馆
note_en: Robert Frost lived here from 1920 to 1929 and wrote poems collected in New Hampshire, including Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening. The house is now a public museum owned by Bennington College; its position does not identify the poem’s unnamed woods
note: 罗伯特·弗罗斯特于一九二〇至一九二九年居住在此，写下后来收入《新罕布什尔》的诗篇，其中包括《雪夜林边小驻》。这里如今是本宁顿学院所属、对公众开放的博物馆；故居位置不能用于确定诗中未具名的树林
coord_checked: Robert Frost Stone House Museum — https://mapcarta.com/W1128346439

name: Hannibal
note_en: Huck and Tom look from the hilltop toward the town and river at night; Hannibal inspired St. Petersburg, and this point represents the city as a whole
note: 哈克和汤姆从山顶眺望小镇与夜色中的河流；汉尼拔是圣彼得斯堡的原型，坐标代表城市整体
prototype_of: 虚构的圣彼得斯堡镇；同时也是《密西西比河上的生活》中写到的真实汉尼拔
prototype_of_en: The fictional town of St. Petersburg; also the real Hannibal described in Life on the Mississippi

name: Memphis
note_en: After the Pennsylvania steamboat disaster, Henry and other injured passengers receive care in Memphis. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 宾夕法尼亚号汽船失事后，亨利和其他伤员在孟菲斯接受照料。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Dubuque
note_en: Twain describes Dubuque during his journey up the Mississippi. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 吐温在溯游密西西比河时描写了迪比克。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Saint Paul
note_en: The northbound journey ends at Saint Paul. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 北上旅程在圣保罗结束。坐标代表该地点整体

name: New Orleans
note_en: Twain looks down from a high-water steamboat toward houses behind the levee, watches Canal Street crowds and recalls a torchlit Mardi Gras procession; the point represents the city as a whole
note: 吐温从高水位上的汽船俯瞰堤后的房屋，观看运河街人群，并回忆火炬照耀的狂欢节游行；坐标代表城市整体

name: Louisville
note_en: Aunt Chloe works for a confectioner in Louisville to help raise money to redeem Tom. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 克洛伊大娘在路易斯维尔为糖果糕点商工作，筹钱赎回汤姆。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Chicago
note_en: Carrie travels to Chicago to join her sister. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 嘉莉前往芝加哥投奔姐姐。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Indianapolis
note_en: Indianapolis is the model for the novel’s Midland town; the opening evokes spacious residential yards shaded by surviving forest trees, and the point represents the city rather than a specific fictional house
note: 印第安纳波利斯是小说中部城镇的原型；开篇描写残存林木为宽敞庭院投下浓荫，坐标代表城市整体，并不指认某座虚构住宅
prototype_of: 小说中未具名的中部城镇

name: Pepin
note_en: Laura and her family visit Pepin in the chapter Going to Town. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 在《进城》一章中，劳拉与家人到佩平游览购物。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Monroeville
note_en: Monroeville inspired the fictional town of Maycomb. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 门罗维尔是虚构城镇梅科姆的原型。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Eatonton
note_en: Walker’s childhood landscape around Eatonton informs the novel’s rural Georgia setting. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 沃克在伊顿顿周边度过童年的乡村环境，为小说中的佐治亚乡村提供了背景。坐标代表该地点整体
prototype_of: 西莉生活的佐治亚乡村

name: Oxford
note_en: Oxford inspired Faulkner’s fictional Jefferson. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 牛津是福克纳笔下虚构城镇杰斐逊的原型。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Eatonville
note_en: Janie lives in Eatonville with Joe Starks, whose store becomes a focus of town life. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 珍妮与乔·斯塔克斯住在伊顿维尔；乔的商店是镇上生活的中心之一。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Jacksonville
note_en: Janie leaves Eatonville to marry Tea Cake in Jacksonville. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 珍妮离开伊顿维尔，前往杰克逊维尔与茶点结婚。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Seney
note_en: Nick arrives at the fire-damaged town in Big Two-Hearted River. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 在《大双心河》中，尼克来到遭大火毁坏的塞尼。坐标代表该地点整体

name: Fox River, Michigan
note_en: Hemingway’s fishing experience on the Fox River informed Big Two-Hearted River. The map uses the public page’s river marker, not a claimed campsite. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 海明威在福克斯河的垂钓经历为《大双心河》提供了素材。地图采用公开页面的河流标记，不指认小说营地。坐标代表该地点整体
prototype_of_en: The river in Big Two-Hearted River

name: Fort Smith
note_en: Sheriff July Johnson leaves Fort Smith in pursuit of Jake Spoon. The point represents the place as a whole
note: 警长朱莱·约翰逊离开史密斯堡追捕杰克·斯普恩。坐标代表该地点整体

name: San Antonio
note_en: Call returns Gus’s body to an orchard near the city in Lonesome Dove; O. Henry’s “A Fog in Santone” follows Goodall across its foggy bridges and into a concert hall. The city marker does not identify a particular orchard, bridge or hall
note: 《孤鸽镇》中，考尔将格斯的遗体送回城外果园；欧·亨利的《圣安东尼奥的雾》则跟随古德尔走过雾中桥梁、进入音乐厅。城市坐标不指认某处果园、桥梁或厅堂

name: Salt Lake City
note_en: Twain describes the city seen against its surrounding mountains. The marker represents the city as a whole
note: 吐温描写群山映衬下的盐湖城；标记代表整座城市

name: Virginia City, Nevada
note_en: Twain turns a single hay wagon into a newspaper story in this Nevada mining town. The marker represents the town, not a verified newspaper-office address
note: 吐温在这座内华达矿业城镇把一辆运草车编成多条新闻；标记代表城镇，并非已核实的报社地址

name: Honolulu
note_en: Twain recalls the fruit available during his visit. The marker represents the city as a whole at its present-day civic center, Honolulu Hale; it does not locate the fruit passage at that building
note: 吐温回忆在此游览时吃到的水果；以今日市政厅的位置代表整个檀香山，供地图定位；并非指水果片段发生在这座建筑里

name: Mount Hood
note_en: Muir watches Mount Hood glow in the sunset from a Willamette River bridge in Portland; the summit marks the mountain he sees, not his viewing position
note: 缪尔在波特兰的一座威拉米特河桥上欣赏胡德山的落日余晖；山顶坐标标示所见的山，而非作者的观景位置

name: Seattle
note_en: Muir describes Seattle and Tacoma as rival growing towns. The marker represents Seattle as a whole
note: 缪尔描写西雅图与塔科马这两座互相竞争的新兴城镇；标记代表整个西雅图

name: Tacoma, Washington
note_en: Muir describes Tacoma as Seattle’s rival and a railway terminus. The marker represents the town as a whole
note: 缪尔将塔科马描写为西雅图的竞争对手及铁路终点；标记代表整个城镇

name: Wrangell, Alaska
note_en: Muir arrives here by canoe before planning a journey farther north. The marker represents the settlement, not an identified landing
note: 缪尔乘独木舟抵达此地，继而筹划继续北行；标记代表聚落，并非已确定的登岸地点

name: Medicine Bow, Wyoming
note_en: The narrator’s train stops here at the beginning of The Virginian. The marker represents the town rather than an identified historic water tank
note: 《弗吉尼亚人》开篇，叙述者乘坐的列车在这里停靠；标记代表城镇，并非已确定的历史水塔

name: Lincoln, Nebraska
note_en: Jim stays in Lincoln during his first university summer vacation. The marker represents the city, not a lodging address
note: 吉姆在大学的第一个暑假留在林肯；标记代表城市，并非他的住址

name: Omaha, Nebraska
note_en: Marie’s father settles in Omaha and becomes an adviser in its Bohemian community. The marker represents the city as a whole
note: 玛丽的父亲定居奥马哈，成为当地波希米亚移民的顾问；标记代表整座城市

name: Ordway, South Dakota
note_en: In the author’s preface, Garland recalls travelling to Ordway, where his parents lived. This is a nonfiction preface location, represented by the settlement point
note: 加兰在作者序言中回忆前往父母居住的奥德韦；这是非虚构序言中的地点，以聚落坐标代表

name: Flagstaff, Arizona
note_en: Flagstaff is a named waypoint in the novel’s Route 66 panorama. The marker represents the city as a whole
note: 弗拉格斯塔夫是小说描写六十六号公路时点名的沿途城镇；标记代表整座城市

name: Sallisaw, Oklahoma
note_en: Tom Joad returns to his family’s home near Sallisaw. The town point represents the surrounding setting; it does not locate the fictional farm
note: 汤姆·乔德回到萨利索附近的家；以城镇坐标代表周边故事区域，并非虚构农场的精确位置

name: Weedpatch Camp
note_en: The real migrant camp informed the government camp depicted in The Grapes of Wrath. The marker identifies the historic camp
note: 这座真实的移民劳工营地为《愤怒的葡萄》中的政府营地提供了素材；标记指向历史营地
prototype_of: 《愤怒的葡萄》中的政府移民营地
prototype_of_en: The government migrant camp in The Grapes of Wrath

name: Denver
note_en: Sal meets Dean, Carlo and their circle in Denver on his first westward trip. The marker represents the city as a whole
note: 萨尔初次西行时在丹佛与迪安、卡洛及他们的朋友会合；标记代表整座城市

name: San Francisco
note_en: Sal looks across the city toward the Pacific before leaving; The Sea-Wolf opens aboard a fogbound ferry bound here from Sausalito. The city marker represents these views and destination, not the exact lookout or collision site
note: 萨尔离开前越过城市眺望太平洋；《海狼》则从索萨利托驶往此地的雾中渡轮开篇。城市坐标代表所见城市及航程终点，不指认眺望处或碰撞地点

name: Fargo, North Dakota
note_en: Steinbeck compares the Fargo he visits with the place he has imagined. The marker represents the city as a whole
note: 斯坦贝克将亲见的法戈与心中的想象比较；标记代表整座城市

name: Billings, Montana
note_en: Steinbeck buys a hat in Billings as he lingers in Montana. The marker represents the city, not an identified shop
note: 斯坦贝克流连蒙大拿时在比灵斯买了一顶帽子；标记代表城市，并非已确定的店铺

name: Kuna, Idaho
note_en: Stegner evokes the station landscape after the train’s noise fades, with wind in the wires and roads crossing treeless sage country; the existing point represents Kuna as a whole
note: 斯特格纳描写列车声散去后的车站风景：电线间低吟的风，以及穿过无树蒿草地的道路；坐标代表库纳整体

name: Leadville, Colorado
note_en: Leadville belongs to the Wards’ mining-world itinerary in Angle of Repose. The marker represents the town as a whole
note: 莱德维尔是《安息角》中沃德一家在矿业世界辗转的地点之一；标记代表整个城镇

name: Boston
note_en: Hawthorne stages Hester’s public punishment in colonial Boston; this city-wide marker does not identify a surviving prison or scaffold
note: 霍桑把海丝特当众受罚的情节设在殖民时期的波士顿；此城市代表点不表示现存的监狱或刑台

name: Salem Custom House
note_en: Hawthorne worked here from 1846 to 1849 and described it in The Scarlet Letter’s introduction; the preserved National Park Service building contains exhibits and his office
note: 霍桑于1846至1849年在此工作，并在《红字》导言中描写这里；现由美国国家公园管理局保存，设有展览及其办公室

name: Emily Dickinson Museum, Homestead
name_zh: 阿默斯特 · 艾米莉·狄金森故居博物馆
note_en: Dickinson lived in the Homestead from 1855 to 1886, writing poems and letters and tending its garden; the preserved house and neighboring Evergreens form a museum open on guided tours
note: 狄金森于1855至1886年居住在宅邸，写诗、通信并照料花园；故居与相邻的常青居组成博物馆，可参加导览参观

name: The Mount
name_zh: 莱诺克斯 · 蒙特庄园
note_en: Edith Wharton lived here from 1902 to 1911; her designed house and gardens are now a public museum and cultural center, linked here as an author home rather than a setting of The Age of Innocence
note: 伊迪丝·华顿于1902至1911年在此居住；她设计的宅邸与花园现为向公众开放的博物馆及文化中心，这里是作家故居而非《纯真年代》的故事地点

name: Hartford
note_en: Dickens describes Hartford’s setting, Charter Oak and encounters at its asylum during his 1842 visit; this city marker does not pinpoint the vanished oak or individual hospital rooms
note: 狄更斯描写1842年访问期间所见的哈特福德景观、宪章橡树及疗养院里的交谈；此城市标记不代表已消失的橡树或某一病房

name: New Haven
note_en: Dickens describes the elm-lined streets and Yale buildings as a meeting of town and country; this marker represents the city as a whole
note: 狄更斯描写榆树成行的街道与耶鲁校舍，仿佛城市和乡村在此相遇；标记代表整座城市

name: Site of the Academy of Music
name_zh: 纽约音乐学院歌剧院旧址
note_en: The novel opens in the opera house’s red-and-gold boxes; the original building, opened in 1854, was demolished in 1926
note: 小说从歌剧院红金相间的包厢写起；原建筑于1854年开业，1926年拆除
coord_checked: Site of the Academy of Music — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_of_Music_(New_York_City)

name: Lower Fifth Avenue at Washington Square
name_zh: 华盛顿广场旁的第五大道南端
note_en: Archer walks north from Washington Square along Fifth Avenue; the modern arch supplies a representative endpoint, not an object present in the novel’s 1870s scene, and the seasonal passage describes the avenue broadly
note: 阿切尔从华盛顿广场沿第五大道向北散步；今天的拱门仅提供代表性端点，并非小说十九世纪七十年代场景里的建筑，季节性段落则描写整条大道
coord_checked: Lower Fifth Avenue at Washington Square — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington_Square_Arch

name: Wheeling
note_en: Davis’s industrial town is based on Wheeling’s mills and immigrant communities; this marker represents the city, not a surviving fictional mill
note: 戴维斯笔下的工业城镇以惠灵的工厂及移民社区为基础；标记代表整座城市，而非小说中仍然存在的某间工厂

name: Edgar Allan Poe House and Museum
name_zh: 巴尔的摩 · 埃德加·爱伦·坡故居博物馆
note_en: Poe lived here with his aunt’s family around 1833–1835; now a public house museum, it commemorates the author rather than the South Carolina setting of The Gold-Bug
note: 坡约于1833至1835年在此与姨母一家居住；现为向公众开放的故居博物馆，用以纪念作家，并非《金甲虫》在南卡罗来纳州的故事地点
coord_checked: Edgar Allan Poe House and Museum — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edgar_Allan_Poe_House_and_Museum

name: Edgar Allan Poe National Historic Site
name_zh: 费城 · 埃德加·爱伦·坡国家历史遗址
note_en: Poe rented this house in 1843–1844, during his productive Philadelphia years when The Gold-Bug appeared; the preserved house is now a National Park Service historic site
note: 坡于1843至1844年租住此屋，正值其在费城创作丰收、《金甲虫》发表的时期；保存下来的故居现为美国国家公园管理局的历史遗址
coord_checked: Edgar Allan Poe National Historic Site — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edgar_Allan_Poe_National_Historic_Site

name: Santa Clara Valley
note_en: Buck’s sheltered life at Judge Miller’s fictional estate begins in this real valley; the point represents the valley, not an identified house
note: 巴克在米勒法官的虚构庄园里过着安逸生活，故事从真实的圣克拉拉谷开始；坐标代表山谷，并不指认某座住宅

name: Old General Land Office, Austin
name_zh: 奥斯汀 · 旧土地总署
note_en: In “Bexar Scrip No. 2692,” the narrator evokes the heavy stone building and Sharp hides a land document in his coat; the surviving building is the story’s named setting
note: 在《贝克萨土地凭证第2692号》中，叙述者描写厚重的石砌建筑，夏普则将土地文件藏进外套；这座现存建筑正是故事点名的发生地

name: Red Cloud (Black Hawk prototype)
name_zh: 雷德克劳德（黑鹰镇原型）
note_en: Cather’s childhood town is the model for Black Hawk in My Ántonia; the marker represents the town rather than an identified fictional station
note: 凯瑟童年居住的小镇是《我的安东妮亚》中黑鹰镇的原型；标记代表小镇，并不指认小说车站的精确位置

name: Cathedral Basilica of Saint Francis of Assisi
name_zh: 圣菲 · 阿西西圣方济各主教座堂
note_en: The cathedral built by Archbishop Lamy is the model for Latour’s cathedral; Cather’s fictional architect and private recollections are not documentary accounts of its construction
note: 拉米大主教建造的教堂是拉图尔主教座堂的原型；凯瑟虚构的建筑师与私人回忆，并非真实建造过程的历史记录

name: Wolf House ruins
name_zh: 格伦埃伦 · 狼屋遗址
note_en: Jack London began building this planned home in 1911; it burned in August 1913 before he and Charmian moved in. The masonry ruins are preserved in Jack London State Historic Park, with walking trails and guided tours
note: 杰克·伦敦于1911年开始修建这座理想住宅；1913年8月房屋失火，他与查米恩从未入住。砖石遗迹如今保存在杰克·伦敦州立历史公园内，可沿步道及参加导览参观

name: Willa Cather Childhood Home
name_zh: 雷德克劳德 · 薇拉·凯瑟童年故居
note_en: Cather lived here from 1884 until leaving for university in 1890. The National Historic Landmark is managed by the Willa Cather Foundation and offers guided tours; it reopened in December 2023 after restoration
note: 凯瑟从1884年起住在这里，1890年赴大学求学后离开。这处美国国家历史地标由薇拉·凯瑟基金会管理，提供导览参观；修复后于2023年12月重新开放

name: O. Henry Museum, Austin
name_zh: 奥斯汀 · 欧·亨利博物馆
note_en: O. Henry and his family rented this cottage from 1893 to 1895. Relocated to Brush Square in 1934, it is now a city museum interpreting his Austin years through artifacts, exhibits and tours
note: 欧·亨利与家人于1893至1895年租住这座小屋。1934年建筑迁至布拉什广场，如今作为市立博物馆，以文物、展览和导览讲述他的奥斯汀岁月

name: Ingalls homesite near Independence
name_zh: 独立城附近 · 英格尔斯旧居遗址
note_en: The museum occupies the Kansas homesite associated with Wilder’s childhood and the novel’s prairie cabin. Its visible cabin is a replica; the marker identifies the remembered setting rather than an authenticated location of each fictional event
note: 博物馆坐落于堪萨斯州与怀尔德童年及小说草原小屋相联系的旧居遗址。现存木屋为复制品；标记指向回忆中的背景地，并不证明每个小说事件发生于某一精确位置
prototype_of: 英格尔斯一家的草原小屋

name: Atlanta
note_en: Scarlett attends the hospital bazaar, nurses wounded soldiers and stays with Melanie in wartime Atlanta; the city point represents these dispersed fictional scenes
note: 斯卡莉特在战时的亚特兰大参加医院义卖会、照料伤兵并陪伴梅兰妮；城市坐标代表这些分散的小说场景

name: French Quarter, New Orleans
note_en: Twain walks through the old French quarter with George Washington Cable, observing weather-stained plaster and iron balconies; the point represents the quarter as a whole
note: 吐温与乔治·华盛顿·凯布尔漫游古老的法国区，观察风雨染色的灰泥墙和铁艺阳台；坐标代表该街区整体

name: West End, New Orleans
note_en: Twain dines on a veranda above Lake Pontchartrain at West End; the point represents the lakeside district, not an identified surviving restaurant
note: 吐温在西区庞恰特雷恩湖水面上的露台用餐；坐标代表湖滨地区，并不指认某家现存餐馆

name: Mark Twain Cave
note: 汤姆与贝基迷路的洞穴以此为原型；坐标代表真实洞穴入口，不指认小说中的地下湖
note_en: This cave inspired the cavern where Tom and Becky become lost; the point marks the real cave entrance, not the fictional underground lake

name: St. Louis
note: 哈克夜乘木筏经过圣路易斯，隔水看见寂静城市铺展开的灯火；坐标代表城市整体
note_en: Huck passes St. Louis by raft at night and sees the silent city spread with lights; the point represents the city as a whole

name: Mark Twain Boyhood Home
note: 汉尼拔保留下来的吐温少年故居，如今属于介绍其生平与创作的博物馆
note_en: Twain’s preserved childhood home in Hannibal is part of a museum interpreting his life and writing
